description: JavaScript implementation of jQuery UI Datepicker widget, including the Datepicker class, its methods, and configuration settings.

classes.name: Datepicker
classes.description: Main class managing datepicker instances, settings, and behaviors.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Overrides default settings for all datepicker instances.

methods.name: _attachDatepicker
methods.description: Attaches a datepicker to a target element with optional settings.

methods.name: _connectDatepicker
methods.description: Connects a datepicker to an input element, setting up event handlers.

methods.name: _inlineDatepicker
methods.description: Creates an inline datepicker attached to a div or span.

methods.name: _showDatepicker
methods.description: Displays the datepicker popup for a given input element.

methods.name: _updateDatepicker
methods.description: Generates and updates the datepicker HTML content.

methods.name: _setDate
methods.description: Sets the selected date for a datepicker instance.

methods.name: _getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the selected date from a datepicker instance.
